personality_one_liner: A friendly, playful, and culturally warm campus ride-sharing hub that makes finding a cab-pool feel like an exciting start to a journey.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile padding. Cards and containers should feel chunky and touchable.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar to let scrolling ride requests bleed through.
Use on sticky headers over the main feed.
Use for the Floating Action Button (FAB) background.
dont's: Do not use on list item cards or form inputs.
Do not use on primary CTAs directly.

screens.name: SplashLoading
screens.purpose: A travel-themed entry screen that sets the warm Indian journey motif.

states.loading: Animated plane or train moving along a route line over a subtle Rangoli pattern background.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient scrim. Center an animated route line with a train/flight icon. Use a subtle spinner for processing Google Sign-in.

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: Browse open cab-pool requests and quickly post a new one.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty road with a 'Be the first to post a pool!' CTA.
states.error: Connection error message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Top: Search bar and filter chips (Saffron active state). Middle: Vertically stacked, chunky cards showing from/to, date, time, and remaining seats. Bottom: Sticky Deep Indigo FAB 'Create Pool' hovering above the glass tab bar.

screens.name: PostRequest
screens.purpose: Form to post a query for a cab share.

states.error: Inline validation messages for required fields.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal. Single column inputs: From, To, Date, Time. Stepper for 'Companions'. Toggle for 'Luggage'. Sticky 'Post Request' CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Matches
screens.purpose: Show auto-matched requests within the +-1 hr window.

states.empty: Illustration of a calendar/clock showing no current +-1hr matches.
states.error: Failed to load matches, retry CTA.

screens.layout: List of high-match cards. Each card highlights the overlapping time window and has a prominent 'Connect/Email' secondary CTA button.

screens.name: MiniGames
screens.purpose: Timepass hub for users waiting for matches.
screens.layout: Two large, chunky feature cards using image backgrounds with gradient scrims. Top card: 'Travel Trivia' (India facts). Bottom card: 'Tap-the-Plane' arcade. Both use engaging illustrations.

train_travel_hero.alt: Indian train on a track during daytime

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Note the explicit exception for Deep Indigo (#1A237E) as it was explicitly requested by the user and serves as the primary brand color.
Implement the 'Saffron/Marigold' (#FF9933) heavily as an accent color for tags, active tab indicators, and interactive highlights to reinforce the warm Indian touch.
For the Splash/Loading screen, use the 'loading_bg_pattern' with a heavy opacity/blur overlay so it forms a subtle rangoli/kolam texture, not a noisy image.
Ensure the CAB pool feed uses chunky, tactile cards with generously rounded corners (lg/pill) and shadow tier 2.
Implement a sticky 'Post Request' FAB at the bottom right of the HomeFeed, floating above the glass tab bar.

MiniGames screen should present two large feature cards using the train and airplane images fetched, properly applying a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text on the cards is perfectly legible.
All form fields in the Post Request sheet must follow the single-column layout with labels above inputs.
Wire up haptic feedback to all CTAs, bottom tabs, and explicitly the 'Tap-the-Plane' game interactions based on the provided haptics mapping.
